question: What does an egress/mofrp account need to register, and how much traffic does the daily check-in grant? The public pages state neither: console.mofrp.com/login and /register serve one password login page, the register link has an empty target, and terms.mofrp.com, api-docs.mofrp.com and status.mofrp.com answered HTTP 530 on 2026-11-03.
why: The record's rung cannot be raised above unverified: the quota amount and the identity gate are behind a sign-up, so they are unverified: behind a sign-up. The free-service promise, the check-in model and the protocol stack are documented from the vendor's front page.
